verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers integration mechanics, catalog feeds, cart APIs, dispute-management tools (list_disputes, accept_dispute_claim), webhooks, and fee schedules, but nowhere documents specific fraud-liability or chargeback-risk allocation rules for agent-initiated transactions (e.g., who bears loss when an AI agent completes checkout, liability shift terms, or agent-specific fraud protections). Dispute API endpoints are operational tooling, not risk-allocation policy documentation, and the fee page explicitly has no separate agentic-channel terms.
